changes: Bitcoin and Dogecoin support across the wallet and offline recovery tool; legacy Komodo recovery extended to SHIC (PEP/SHIC only).
Automatic, read-only BTC/LTC fees based on transaction size, including inputs and outputs; fresh USD pricing, warnings above $5 and a hard block above $100 with no override.
Optional 1-coin total fee for PEP/DOGE/SHIC/WHT and improved handling of wallets with many outputs; transaction input limits and explicit confirmation remain in place.
Verified backup servers where available, automatic connection retries and authenticated public-address caching for faster Receive loading.
Optional password-encrypted local recovery copies, manual restore after reinstall, and no coins enabled by default on new wallets; existing backups and selections remain compatible.
Refreshed branding, compact screens and controls, soft button glow, improved light mode, activity pagination and explorer links, and a 2.3-second splash screen.
Clearer README and fee/recovery documentation, expanded automated coverage and independent Bitcoin Core regtest verification using disposable coins; no real BTC test or independent security audit.
